summary: ADR-0048 accepted 2026-07-26; repository source and Accepted ADRs are fact authority; projections/indexes are derived_cache only; deterministic Locator returns locations, hashes, provenance, ranking evidence, confidence, never synthesized facts; callers must reread and hash-verify; trusted adapters bound domain/path/snapshot/budget/confidence, caller query intent cannot widen bounds; VDD records post-reread accept/reject, rejected candidates cannot satisfy required modules, uncovered modules block readiness; Quick Dev uses only VDD-frozen decisions; Bootstrap Review freezes accepted context in Artifact View; no post-freeze expansion; ambiguity fallback disabled unless approved, then Python uses scripts/sc/_llm_backend.py::run_llm_exec; maintenance pins local refs/heads/main, no implicit fetch/checkout/merge/branch mutation, only derived artifacts and append-only evidence; extends ADR-0044; complements and does not supersede ADR-0037/0041/0043/0044; fail closed on missing, stale, low-confidence, out-of-policy, hash drift; no authorization for phase routes, Hosted E2 changes, live metadata, deployment, acceptance, handoff, release, commit
